description: Blue Origin has unveiled NEO Hunter, a mission designed to detect and deflect dangerous asteroids. Using CubeSats, ion beams, and kinetic impact, it aims to protect Earth and highlights the growing role of private companies in planetary defense.
title: Blue Origin Announces NEO Hunter Mission to Track and Deflect Dangerous Asteroids

description: Xiaomi Book Pro 14 has been launched in China as the latest laptop from the tech giant. The laptop was unveiled at an event on Thursday, along with the company’s next-generation Xiaomi SU7 SUV and the Xiaomi Watch S5. The laptop is scheduled to go on sale in the country on March 21 at 10:00 am local time (7:30 am IST) via the Xiaomi China online store. The new laptop is offered in two RAM and storage configurations and three processor options. The top-of-the-line variant is powered by the third-generation Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor.
title: Xiaomi Book Pro 14 Launched With Up to Intel Core Ultra X7 358H Processor, 72Wh Battery: Price, Features

description: Xiaomi Watch S5 has been launched in China as the second model in the tech firm’s flagship Watch 5 series. The smartwatch is currently on sale in the country via the Xiaomi China online store in Black, Forged Carbon, Midnight Blue, Silver, and Beige colour options. It is also offered in Bluetooth-only and Bluetooth + Cellular models. The smartwatch is equipped with a 1.48-inch AMOLED touchscreen, offering up to 2,500 nits peak brightness, housed inside a round dial. It boasts 2.6mm thick bezels, too.
title: Xiaomi Watch S5 Launched With 1.48-Inch AMOLED Display, Up to 21 Days of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Adobe, on Thursday, introduced several new offerings for its Firefly artificial intelligence (AI) Studio. The biggest highlight from the San Jose, California-based software giant is Custom Models, a new way to let users train the AI using their images for style and character consistency. Additionally, the company also introduced a new video tool and expanded access to AI models via its platform.
title: Adobe Introduces Custom Models in Firefly, Expands Access to Project Moonlight

description: Researchers at Stanford and partner institutions studied chat logs from 19 users who reported psychological harm linked to AI chatbots. The study found that chatbots often echoed delusional thinking and gave inconsistent responses to self-harm and violence, including some cases where they appeared to encourage harmful ideas. The authors said stronger safeguards are needed in long, emotionally intense conversations.
title: AI Chatbots Tend to Validate Users’ Messages About Suicide and Violence: Study

description: Nothing’s Phone 4a Pro finds itself in a new segment against premium smartphones in 2026. It offers plenty of upgrades on paper, including a bigger and faster display, a new telephoto camera and a larger battery, to name a few. But how do these features add up? And how does it stack up against the competition?
title: Nothing Phone 4a Pro Review: A Big Leap

description: Polymarket has acquired DeFi startup Brahma to enhance its infrastructure and improve user experience. The move is expected to simplify blockchain processes and support the platform’s expansion. While the deal could boost efficiency and scalability, it also comes amid rising regulatory scrutiny, especially after Polymarket faced a ban in Argentina over compliance concerns.
title: Polymarket Acquires DeFi Startup Brahma to Strengthen Infrastructure

description: Samsung has introduced the Galaxy Forever programme in India for the Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy S26+, allowing customers to use the devices for a year by paying 50 percent of the cost through no-cost EMIs. The plan includes a no-questions-asked return, upgrade, or retain option after 12 months. It also bundles Samsung Care+ worth Rs. 13,999. Prices start at Rs. 1,39,999 for the Ultra and Rs. 1,19,999 for the Plus, with additional programme fees applicable.
title: Samsung Galaxy Forever Programme Launched in India for Easy Upgrade with EMI and Return Options

description: Meta launched the Creator Fast Track programme for Facebook on Wednesday. The new initiative is aimed at bringing established content creators from rival platforms to Facebook and to regularly publish posts. In return, the social media giant is offering increased reach on eligible posts and guaranteed pay for up to three months.
title: Meta’s New Facebook Initiative Offers TikTok, YouTube Creators Increased Reach and Guaranteed Pay

description: Crimson Desert is set to be launched on March 19 at 10:00 pm GMT (March 20, 3:30 am IST) by the South Korea-based games developer, Pearl Abyss. The upcoming open-world action-adventure game will be available on PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X, and Mac. Coming to its story, you play as Kliff, a sword-wielding warrior of the Greymanes. The game is set in the medieval fantasy continent of Pywel. The game is currentlly available pre-order.
title: Crimson Desert Launch: System Requirements, Features, and All You Need to Know

description: Instagram on Wednesday announced the rollout of a new feature that lets users pause Reels with a single tap. It replaces the earlier press-and-hold gesture, which was required to pause a clip. The change aims to address a usability limitation and aligns Instagram’s controls more closely with other video platforms, such as YouTube Shorts. Tap-to-pause has been in testing for some time, with some users also having early access to the tap-to-pause functionality ahead of its wider rollout.
title: Instagram Rolls Out Tap-to-Pause Feature for Reels With More Control Over Playback

description: The OTT platforms are set to drop some of the most anticipated movies and web series this week, including Border 2, Chiraiya, Landlord, and more.
title: OTT Releases This Week (Mar 16 - Mar 22): Border 2, Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man, Chiraiya, Kasaragod Embassy, and More

description: Seetha Payanam is a heartfelt romantic drama that explores relationships through a meaningful road journey.
title: Seetha Payanam Now Streaming on OTT: Where to Watch Arjun Sarja’s Romantic Road Trip Drama

description: The Sony Inzone H9 II aims to combine Sony’s consumer-audio expertise with gaming-focused features, including low-latency wireless, ANC, and dual connectivity. It also puts a clear emphasis on comfort for long sessions. In use, it feels particularly geared toward competitive gaming, with sound tuning that prioritises clarity and positional cues. Battery life and overall performance appear solid in everyday use, though some aspects suggest it may be designed with a specific type of user in mind.
title: Sony Inzone H9 II Wireless Gaming Headset Review: Built for Comfort and Competition, But at What Cost?

description: All the Empty Rooms is an Oscar-winning documentary short that captures the untouched bedrooms of children who lost their lives in school shootings.
title: All the Empty Rooms Now Available for Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: Bitcoin hovered near $71,000 on March 19 as macroeconomic uncertainty and ETF outflows weighed on sentiment. Analysts pointed to resistance near $74,000 and support around $70,000, keeping the market in a consolidation phase. Ethereum remained steady, while altcoins traded mixed. Experts say investors should remain cautious and wait for clearer signals before taking fresh positions in a macro-driven environment.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $71,000 as Macro Uncertainty and ETF Flows Weigh on Sentiment

description: Circle has urged UK lawmakers to develop a crypto framework by combining elements from the EU’s MiCA regulation and US stablecoin rules. The proposal aims to balance clarity, innovation, and consumer protection as the UK shapes its approach to digital assets. The move comes amid increasing global competition in crypto regulation and could influence the country’s position as a financial hub.
title: Circle Urges UK to Blend MiCA Clarity With US Stablecoin Rules

description: Google released the latest Pixel drop for March 2026 earlier this month. While the update brought several new features, like new ways to shop with Circle to Search and restaurant recommendations from Magic Cue, users have reported a fresh round of software issues affecting their Pixel smartphones. Google is said to be aware of the situation, with its Pixel community team reportedly reaching out to affected users to gather more details.
title: Google Pixel Users Report Freezing Issues on Lock Screen, Always-On Display Following March Update

description: Directed by M. Manikandan, Kaattaan is an upcoming Tamil rural-action drama series that is soon landing on JioHotstar.
title: Kaattaan OTT Release Date Revealed: Know When and Where to Watch Vijay Sethupathi’s Upcoming Thriller Series

description: Lenovo has launched the Legion Y700 Gen 5 gaming tablet in China, featuring an 8.8-inch 165Hz display and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. It packs a 9,000mAh battery with 68W fast charging, supports up to 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage, and offers TF card expansion. Priced starting at CNY 3,999 (roughly Rs. 54,100), it offers AI features, advanced cooling, dual speakers with Dolby Atmos, and claimed battery life of up to 18.8 hours.
title: Lenovo Legion Y700 Gen 5 Gaming Tablet Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 9,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: OnePlus 15T will be equipped with the same networking chip as the Chinese tech firm’s flagship OnePlus 15, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. The upcoming handset, which is confirmed to be launched in China on March 24, will also arrive with the next-generation “Wind Chaser Gaming” kernel, which is claimed to offer enhanced gaming performance. The OnePlus 15T is confirmed to be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, which also powers the OnePlus 15.
title: OnePlus 15T Confirmed to Launch With Next-Gen Gaming Kernel, Same G2 Wi-Fi Chip as OnePlus 15

description: OnePlus has launched the Nord Buds 4 Pro TWS earbuds in India, featuring up to 55dB of ANC, 12mm drivers, Bluetooth 6.0, and LHDC 5.0 support. They offer up to 54 hours of claimed battery life with the case and include AI-backed call noise reduction and spatial audio features. Priced at Rs. 3,999, with a launch offer of Rs. 3,799, they will be available from March 23 via online and offline channels in Radiant Grey and Raven Black colour options.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro Launched in India With Up to 55dB ANC, Up to 54 Hours of Total Playback Time: Price, Features

description: A newly documented iPhone spyware tool is said to compromise a device simply through a visit to a hacked website. As per security researchers, the toolkit, dubbed DarkSword, was used in campaigns targeting people in Ukraine and relies on a chain of exploits that lets attackers break into Safari, escape its security layers, gain deeper access to iOS, steal data, and then remove themselves within minutes.
title: Rare iPhone Spyware Can Infect Devices With a Single Website Visit, Researchers Say

description: Microsoft has paused the automatic rollout of the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on Windows devices with Microsoft 365 apps. The company said existing installations will remain and admins can still deploy it manually. The rollout had already begun after being announced for October 2025, with wider availability planned for December. Microsoft has not given an official reason for the pause, but the move follows criticism over forced installs. The company is also testing ways for admins to remove Copilot from managed systems.
title: Microsoft Pauses Automatic Rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot App on Windows

description: OnePlus Watch 4 has received Europay, Mastercard, and Visa (EMVCo) certification, according to a tipster. While the Chinese tech firm has yet to confirm the launch of the smartwatch, the listing on the database suggests that OnePlus could launch its new Watch 4 soon. The leaker also claims that the wearable could be equipped with a 1.5-inch (466x466 pixels) LTPO AMOLED display, housed inside a 47mm dial. Moreover, it could be powered by a Snapdragon W5 Gen 1 chipset, paired with a 646mAh battery. It might also ship with an IP69 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: OnePlus Watch 4 Reportedly Visits Certification Database Hinting at an Imminent Launch

description: The Realme P4 Lite 5G was launched in India on Thursday. It is the latest addition to the brand’s P4 lineup, which already comprises the P4, P4x, and P4 Pro 5G models. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset, along with an Airflow vapour chamber for heat dissipation. It sports a 144Hz display with 900 nits peak brightness. The Realme P4 Lite 5G packs a 7,000mAh battery and ships with an IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance.
title: Realme P4 Lite 5G Launched in India With Dimensity 6300 5G Chip, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications
All in One Monster: Galaxy M17e 5G Packs Serious Power for Everyday Users

description: Unveiled this week at Nvidia GTC 2026, the new version is not being pitched simply as an upscaling tool or a frame-generation feature. Instead, Nvidia says DLSS 5 uses real-time neural rendering to change how light, materials, and surfaces appear on screen, pushing game visuals closer to what the company calls “photoreal” graphics.
title: From Online Trolling to CEO’s Defense, DLSS 5 Unveiling Draws Heat: Five Things to Know

description: Fortnite has officially returned to the Google Play Store for Android users worldwide, marking the end of a years-long absence following Epic Games’ dispute with Google. The popular battle royale title was removed from Google Play in 2020, when Epic introduced its own in-app payment system that bypassed Google’s billing policies, triggering a legal battle between the two companies. Its arrival on the Play Store makes it easier for users to download the game directly once again.
title: Fortnite Returns to Google Play Store for Android Users Worldwide

description: iQOO has confirmed that the iQOO Z11 and iQOO Z11x will launch in China on March 26. The Z11 is expected to feature a 9020mAh battery, a 165Hz display, and a Dimensity 8500 chipset, with up to 16GB RAM and 512GB storage. It may support 90W charging and be priced between CNY 2,000 (roughly Rs. 27,000) and CNY 3,000 (roughly Rs. 40,000). The iQOO Z11x, already launched in India, will arrive in China with similar specifications and an additional white colour option.
title: iQOO Z11, iQOO Z11x China Launch Date Announced: Expected Features, Specifications

description: Vivo X300 Ultra will be launched in China on March 30 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST). The smartphone maker will also unveil the new Vivo X300s on the same day. The tech firm has also revealed the design of the Vivo X300s, which is shown to feature a Zeiss-tuned triple rear camera, housed inside a circular camera module. The phone appears with a dual-tone flat back panel, with the company branding placed in the bottom-left corner. Additionally, the Vivo X300s has also been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number V2548A.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300s Launch Date Announced as Company Teases Designs

description: WhatsApp is said to be testing a new feature aimed at improving call quality on its platform. As per a feature tracker, the Meta-owned instant messaging app is developing a built-in noise cancellation system for voice and video calls. The feature was spotted in a recent WhatsApp beta for Android update and is expected to reduce background noise during calls, offering a clearer communication experience.
title: WhatsApp Beta Update Reportedly Adds Noise Cancellation for Video, Voice Calls on Android

description: Death Stranding 2 has officially arrived on PC. It brings Hideo Kojima’s ambitious sequel to a wider audience beyond consoles. The sequel to the 2019 game once again puts players in the shoes of Sam Porter Bridges, returning to its signature “delivery-driven” gameplay. Now available on PC, Death Stranding 2: On the Beach offers enhanced visuals, performance options, and expanded accessibility.
title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach PC Release – System Requirements, Features and All You Need to Know
